title: papaia-ctl doctor --json
description: Result of the preflight and diagnostic checks. Additive changes keep schema_version; a breaking change increments it.

checks.description: In registry order. A check that was skipped with --skip, is not applicable, or could not run is reported with status "skip".

name.description: A registered check. A distributed installation adds 'nodes' (each node's own checks, version skew, clock deviation) and 'links' (a TLS handshake per link from the calling side, certificate expiry).

details.description: Raw values behind the summary (bytes, ports, days left, ...), so a consumer does not have to parse the text. Keys differ per check.
Docker Model Runner. `fail` carries `reason`; `pass` and `warn` add the model lists and the host-side TCP state.

engines.description: Engines the runner reports as running.

docker_desktop.description: Docker Desktop version; null when it could not be read.

missing.description: Listed references the runner does not have.

host_tcp.description: Whether the unauthenticated API is served on host port 12434; `unknown` inside a container.

ok.description: True when no check failed; the command exits 0 exactly then.
